generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with edit target and style-reference inputs

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean; source pixels with gradient below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: Neutral form shading and local ambient occlusion are present; no directional cast-shadow field, sun angle, or time-of-day treatment was observed.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median bounding-box width across 29 isolated dark-green conifer components, scaled by 2560/1254; dense merged crowns are an acknowledged source of upward bias.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Broad coherent inland benches count as buildable; exposed cliff and gully faces count as steep; scattered rock, talus, scrub, and denser conifer ground make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster colour classification, connected-component selection, local wet-margin growth, morphological smoothing, and hole fill over the painted coast, surf, wash, stream, tarn, and fall; no polyline geometry.
water_mask.raster_component_note: The three logical water systems contain separate visible raster components where rocks and conifers occlude the painted stream and coast.

source_scale_gate_reproduction.note: Radii 3 and 24 at 1254 px scale to approximately 6.12 and 49.0 px on the 2560 px canvas; the classifier matches the repository blue-fringe predicate.

open_risks: Median conifer crowns measure about 67.37 px / 3.234 m at final canvas scale, below the required 84-147 px / 4-7 m range.

The single edit paints eastern sea through the north-east corner and through two south-east edge runs. The mask includes those wet pixels as required, but the literal north-edge-dry and south-edge-only-at-the-southwest-tarn constraints are not met.
The generated result has not been visually approved by the owner.
